findings: P1 reduced the actual available built-in tool surface to exactly the seven requested Company OS developer tools.
The claude.ai Claude Docs MCP server and all other MCP servers were absent from system/init.
No plugin was loaded and no tool was called.
Skill, agent and slash-command names remain startup metadata, but their callable Skill/Task tool schemas were not present in the observed tools array.
A one-turn no-tool response still created 17,876 cache input tokens, establishing a measurable Claude Code startup/context floor for this configuration.
The requested USD 0.10 max-budget value was exceeded by the completed first turn to USD 0.11184; max-budget is therefore a boundary/stop control, not a strict penny-exact cap.
transcript_encoding_note: Windows PowerShell Tee-Object wrote the local transcript with a UTF-16 BOM, so a later parser that forced UTF-8 raised UnicodeDecodeError. This did not affect the provider run or the visible stream-json evidence.
